restaurant_name: คลินิกทันตกรรมหมอปูน Poon dental clinic
text:
The doctor is kind, the staff provides excellent service, and the clinic is clean.
There's also a play area for children. We're always impressed every time we visit. Highly recommend it! Children will no longer be afraid of dental work if they come here 🙂 …
